# Texas Comptroller tax publications

The index as published at https://comptroller.texas.gov/taxes/publications/ — 92 publications, 95 rows once cross-listings count — in the three orders the Comptroller offers: by subject, by number, by title.

A † marks an address built from the Comptroller’s own pattern that was not seen live when this was built. "Matters to" is this repository’s judgement, by kind of business; "(core)" means read it before doing that kind of work.

## Notes on individual entries

- **2023 Legislative Update** — Its own page was not seen; this points at Tax Policy News, where the update is published.
- **96-385** — A monthly newsletter; this points at its index rather than a single issue.
- **For publications related to Local Government Assistance, see Local Government under Economy.** — A pointer in the index, not a publication.
- **Sales & Use Tax Rate Charts** — Mapped to the Comptroller rate chart seen live; the index link itself was not visible.
- **Texas Sales Tax Rates** — Mapped to the Comptroller sales tax page (rates and the address rate locator).
